scenes.stage_direction: Private memories interrupt the investigation. David listens without competing with either man from Amara's past.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Breakfast. He asked when I opened, then waited until I had time to sit.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: That sounds like a better beginning than the one Victor keeps telling.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: I saved Adrian's message from the day he argued with his family. I haven't listened since he died.

metadata.evidence_summary: Their relationship grew before his promise of marriage.
